shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -i -C 4 'date-components|date-utils' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/
npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -20; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>&1 | tail -15
npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 peerDependencies; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@3.4.2 peerDependencies
npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -5 && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh date-components Calendar DatePicker; grep gravity package.json
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat dist/docs/INDEX.md; rg -n -i -C 4 'setup|styles|install|import' README.md | head -60; ls dist/docs

rg -n 'onUpdate|value\?|defaultValue' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -rn 'loadLocale' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist --include=*.d.ts -l | head -3; rg -n 'loadLocale' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist/*/settings/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -iE 'error|built in'; git status --short
